requirements.description: Click Join Healing Sky in the main navigation and select Join as a Client to open the client registration page.

Fill in the client registration form ONE FIELD AT A TIME, working straight down the page in the exact order the fields appear on screen. Do NOT use fill_form in this scenario: use a separate type_text call for each field so the form is visibly completed step by step, in order. Do not submit in this scenario. Identify each field by its name or placeholder from the page state rather than by position. Step 1, Full Name: type_text '{{fullName}}' into the input named 'fullName'. Step 2, Email: type_text '{{email}}' into the input named 'email' as literal text, with no credential_key. Step 3, Phone Number: type_text '{{phoneE164}}' into the input named 'phoneNumber', keeping the leading +1 because that is what selects the United States country code, and never clicking the small country flag beside the field. Step 4, Date of Birth: one select_options call setting Month '{{dobMonth}}', Date '{{dobDate}}' and Year '{{dobYear}}' together. Step 5, Address Lookup: type_text '{{addressLookup}}' into the input with placeholder 'Address Lookup', wait 2500 ms, call get_page_state and click the first address suggestion so the address resolves to a full address including a postcode. Step 6, LAST of all and only after the address has resolved, Referral Code: type_text '{{referralCode}}' into the input named 'referral_code'. The referral code sits at the bottom of the form and must be the final field entered, never earlier. Finally call get_page_state and confirm every field holds its value rather than placeholder text. The scenario passes when all six fields are set in that order.

Continuing on the completed client registration form, check the form and submit it. 1. Call get_page_state and read back every field. Setting the Date of Birth re-renders the form and can silently clear the phone field, so check that one carefully: if the input named 'phoneNumber' shows only a dialling code such as '+1' with no digits then it is empty. Use one fill_form call to restore anything that is empty, entering '{{phoneE164}}' for 'phoneNumber', '{{fullName}}' for 'fullName', '{{email}}' for 'email', '{{addressLookup}}' for the Address Lookup input and '{{referralCode}}' for 'referral_code'. 2. Scroll down to the very bottom of the registration form and click the Submit button there. It is the last control on the form, directly below the Referral Code field and above the 'Already have an account? Log in' line. Do not scroll back up and do not click any button in the header or anywhere higher on the page, such as 'Join Healing Sky' or 'Switch to Provider'. 3. Wait 5000 ms, call get_page_state, and if nothing has changed wait a further 3000 ms and inspect again. Registration succeeded if EITHER the message 'Registration completed successfully' is displayed OR the application navigates to the client login page (/client/login); either outcome is a pass.

From the Healing Sky homepage, navigate to the client sign-in page, select Email as the OTP delivery method, enter the configured client email mithu@yopmail.com using credential_key clientEmail, and click Log in to open the OTP verification screen.

On the client OTP verification screen, enter the configured OTP bypass value 1234 using credential_key clientOtp into the OTP fields and click Verify. Confirm the sign-in success message 'OTP verified successfully' is displayed, then confirm the authenticated client dashboard (/client/dashboard) is displayed.

Log out from the authenticated client dashboard using the profile menu, as three separate and visible steps. Step 1: click the user profile avatar in the top-right header to open the account dropdown. This control is an icon with no text, so find it by its hint, which mentions profile, avatar or dropdown. Step 2: call get_page_state and confirm the account dropdown is now open, showing the signed-in user's name and account options. Step 3: within that open dropdown, click the log out control. It is an icon with no visible 'Log Out' text, so find it by its hint, which mentions logout or signout, and do not just click the first item in the menu. Then confirm any logout confirmation dialog if one appears. Finally verify the client is signed out and returned to the Healing Sky homepage with the Log in or Sign In option visible again.
